description: Backtest rules (src/backtest/): which past journals can be fetched, how they are ingested, the point-in-time (PIT) policy a backtest score must obey, how a brand's outcome ('launched' or not) is labelled at fixed horizons after filing, and how the precision/recall report is built. Nothing here changes a live score; the report suggests weight changes but never applies them. See docs/BACKTEST.md.

probe._comment: Historical availability probe (python -m src.pipeline backtest probe). One HEAD per candidate journal URL (a 1 KB ranged GET when HEAD is refused), binary search for the earliest journal still downloadable. Polite: at least min_delay_seconds between requests, a hard request cap, honest UKIPO_USER_AGENT.
probe._filename_note: The file name the IPO uses for the machine-readable journal (see src/ingest/ukipo_http.py XML_FILENAME_PATTERNS[0]). Only this pattern is probed: probing every historical pattern for every week would multiply requests for no gain.

ingest._comment: backtest ingest: the normal pipeline with NO web search, NO LLM, and (by default) NO live domain layer -- a paid API is never used by a backtest, and the domain layer describes the present, which is not point-in-time safe.
ingest._max_journals_note: A cap per invocation so one command cannot mass-download. A full ~27-journal backfill is three invocations, or one with --max-journals 27 (see HUMAN_ACTIONS.md).
ingest._delay_note: Pause between journals when the source downloads from ipo.gov.uk (ukipo_http). Each journal is ~150 MB before the embedded artwork is stripped.
ingest._output_subdir_note: Run artefacts (CSV, email, QA report) go to CACHE_DIR/<output_subdir>/<journal>, not reports/runs/: a backtest is not a deliverable week.

pit._comment: Point-in-time policy (src/backtest/pit.py). A backtest score for a filing may use only the stored trade mark record and observations that are point_in_time_safe with source_date <= filing_date + pit_window_days. Everything else is dropped or neutralised before the real LaunchTraceScorer runs.
pit._pit_window_note: 0 = strict: only facts true on or before the filing date. Raising it (e.g. to the ~6-8 week filing-to-publication lag) admits facts LaunchTrace could have known when the journal was published, such as a company incorporated just after filing.
pit._allowed_signals_note: Only these registered PIT-safe signals may enter a backtest context, and only with source_date inside the cutoff. A signal must ALSO be point_in_time_safe on the observation row.
pit._identity_link_note: company_match is not PIT-safe (matching runs against today's register). It is used for ONE thing only: the company number and match confidence that link the applicant to a company whose PIT-safe incorporation_date is inside the cutoff. Without such an incorporation_date the backtest treats the applicant as unmatched. Status, SIC codes and accounts are never used (D-503).

not_evaluable_indicators.food_sic_code_match: current Companies House SIC codes (not PIT-safe)
not_evaluable_indicators.service_business_sic_only: current Companies House SIC codes (not PIT-safe)
not_evaluable_indicators.small_company_accounts: current Companies House accounts category (not PIT-safe)
not_evaluable_indicators.company_dormant: current Companies House accounts category (not PIT-safe)

outcomes._comment: Outcome labeller (src/backtest/labeller.py). A brand is 'launched' at a horizon if ANY available criterion has positive evidence observed on or before filing_date + horizon. 'not_launched' only when no criterion is positive AND at least one criterion has a NEGATIVE check observed within negative_check_tolerance_days of the horizon end. Otherwise 'unknown' (horizon not elapsed, or no evidence). Absence of evidence is never 'not_launched'. Only stored observations are read; the labeller never searches or probes.

criteria.description: The brand's own domain was live with a shop (shop platform detected, or web presence stage live_store).
Companies House accounts made up to a date after the filing (a trading company).
criteria.unavailable_reason: The Companies House data LaunchTrace holds (bulk index and stored matches) has the accounts CATEGORY only, not the made-up-to or filed date of any accounts, and today's company status is not evidence of trading at the horizon. Recorded as unavailable rather than approximated (D-506).

criteria.description: A retailer or marketplace listing was found by a web search already stored (the labeller never runs a search: it is a paid API).

report._comment: backtest report: precision/recall by PIT backtest score band and by indicator, per horizon, unknown labels excluded (and counted). Weight suggestions are advice for a human; nothing is applied.
